candidate_pool_notice: The source-labelled handwriting pool contains printed and English samples too; it is not a pure handwriting benchmark.
selection: Selected exact matches containing Khmer, visually reviewed to exclude obvious printed text, English-only text and uncertain tiny samples. Visual review is not verified writer provenance.
model: Available local CNN-BiLSTM-CTC handwriting fine-tune, step 3000; distinct from unavailable Kaggle Transformer specialist
evaluation_notice: Existing project partition was also used for handwriting fine-tune checkpoint selection; selected demo examples are not general accuracy or an unseen-writer benchmark.
normalization: Original project Khmer cluster normalization applied to source labels and predictions; no labels replaced by predictions.
